scripts.build:sdk: pnpm --filter @sdppp/pptask run build && pnpm --filter @sdppp/pptask-worker-server run build && pnpm --filter @woohaa3/provider-sdk run build
scripts.build:services: pnpm --filter @woohaa3/agent-connections --filter @woohaa3/media-service --filter @woohaa3/task-service --filter @woohaa3/canvas-service --filter @woohaa3/mcp-service --filter @woohaa3/application-service --filter @woohaa3/telemetry-service --filter @woohaa3/extension-oauth-agent --filter @woohaa3/extension-sdk-agent --filter @woohaa3/extension-local-agent run build && pnpm --filter @woohaa3/task-service --filter @woohaa3/canvas-service --filter @woohaa3/mcp-service --filter @woohaa3/application-service run server:build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter @woohaa3/backend run build && pnpm --filter @woohaa3/backend run server:build
scripts.build:units: pnpm run icons:sync && pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:plugins && pnpm run build:services && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.test: pnpm run build:units && pnpm -r run test
